tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search Partle's product catalog by name or description.

    Two distinct modes:

    - **Default (no flags)** — fast keyword search. ~100ms. Acts like a normal
      "dumb" search box: matches the literal words you typed against product
      names and descriptions, with stemming. Good for queries

tools.description:

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description:
Search or list stores in the Partle marketplace.

    Use for store-led questions ("what hardware shops are in Madrid?") rather
    than product-led ones (use `search_products` for that). Pass no query to
    browse the whole catalog.

    Read-only. No authentication. Rate-limited to 100 requests/h

tools.name: get_store
tools.description:

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description:
Get top-level Partle platform statistics.

    Use for size questions ("how big is Partle?", "how many stores does

    data; use `search_products` / `search_stores` for that.

    Read-only. No authentication. Cheap, but rarely

tools.description:
List the caller's personal inventory items.

tools.name: add_inventory_item
tools.description:
Add an item to the caller's personal inventory.

    Authenticated. Required OAuth scope: `inventory:write`.

    One creation tool covers all lifecycle states — set ``status`` based
    on the user's intent: "I bought" → ``owned``, "I want" → ``wanted``,
    "I'm selling" → ``for_sale``. Either ``p

tools.name: update_inventory_item
tools.description:
Patch an existing inventory item. Only provided fields change.

    Authenticated. Required OAuth scope: `inventory:write`. Caller must
    own the item (404 otherwise — we don't leak existence).

    Idempotent: calling twice with the same input yields the same final
    state. For lifecycle conven

tools.name: delete_inventory_item
tools.description:
Permanently delete an inventory row.

    Authenticated. Required OAuth scope: `inventory:write`. Caller must
    own the item (404 otherwise). Hard delete — no soft-delete.

    Args:
        item_id: ID of the row to delete.
        api_key: Optional API key (`pk_*`, generate at /account).

tools.name: mark_for_sale
tools.description:
Move an inventory item to status=for_sale and set listing fields.

    Convenience wrapper over `update_inventory_item` that matches a
    natural user request ("list my drill for sale at 30€"). Sets all
    three columns (`status`, `asking_price`, `asking_currency`, and
    optionally `condition`)

tools.name: mark_sold
tools.description:
Mark an inventory item as sold (status=sold).

    Convenience wrapper over `update_inventory_item` for the natural
    "I sold the drill" request.

    Authenticated. Required OAuth scope: `inventory:write`. Caller must
    own the item.

    Args:
        item_id: ID of the inventory row.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, search_wanted, submit_feedback, create_product, update_product, get_upload_url, upload_product_image · Private data: get_product, get_store, search_wanted, create_buy_request, submit_feedback, create_product, update_product, delete_product, delete_product_image, get_my_products, get_upload_url, upload_product_image, get_my_inventory, add_inventory_item, update_inventory_item, delete_inventory_item, mark_for_sale, mark_sold · Public sink: search_products, get_product, search_wanted, create_buy_request, submit_feedback, create_product, get_upload_url, upload_product_image · Destructive: search_products, delete_product, delete_product_image, add_inventory_item, delete_inventory_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_products, get_product, search_wanted, submit_feedback, create_product, update_product, get_upload_url, upload_product_image · Private data: get_product, get_store, search_wanted, create_buy_request, submit_feedback, create_product, update_product, delete_product, delete_product_image, get_my_products, get_upload_url, upload_product_image, get_my_inventory, add_inventory_item, update_inventory_item, delete_inventory_item, mark_for_sale, mark_sold · Public sink: search_products, get_product, search_wanted, create_buy_request, submit_feedback, create_product, get_upload_url, upload_product_image · Destructive: search_products, delete_product, delete_product_image, add_inventory_item, delete_inventory_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
